question: What supreme attainment makes one dear to the yoginīs?
premises: Enjoyment and liberation constitute a great accomplishment
This accomplishment belongs to the yoginīs
One possessing it becomes dear to them
inference: Attaining the great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation makes one dear to the yoginīs.
plain_english: One may become dear to the yoginīs through the great accomplishment of both enjoyment and liberation.
